compress_video_frames: compress and decompress video frames using PyAV with configurable codec and CRF quality
augment_video_compression: augment video frames with randomly selected CRF values from a predefined list for data augmentation
change_video_speed: change video playback speed by duplicating or dropping frames within a configurable speed range
reorder_video_frames: randomly reorder small chunks of video frames to create temporal discontinuities
apply_temporal_averaging: apply temporal averaging over a sliding window of frames to simulate motion blur effects
